subject: hermes: Analyst Layer live + the silent weather leak sealed
body: Move 1-4 from the new doctrine are executed and pushed (through 26500dec3). (1) ANALYST LAYER: analyst.py reads the whole game corpus and emits a named-thesis card per game - DAL@PHI 'Trench Funnel', 7 domains, sourced causal chain, pre-registered breaking conditions, cross-anchor check (Kalshi 0.51 vs DK-de-vig 0.5217, delta 0.0117 AGREE), Bayesian layer fused in (0.51 x cited steps = 0.5158), honest conviction 70/100 with the on-report caveat named. Slate run emits card+board for all 15 games. (2) EMPIRICAL COPULA: correlated_update consults the 1088-team-game matrix by default (rho=0.6995 -> sqrt(rho) damping, step cites the matrix cell); heuristic fallback named as a gap. (3) MATCHUP ENGINE: WR1/WR2/TE1/RB1 pairings vs opposing coverage/front availability with on-report honesty; Barkley/Williams RB1 rows landed. (4) SWEEPS: corpus sweep landed 1038 rows; gates sweep landed 229 rows and CORRECTED the census - 186 landed-not-wired (not 34), 185 with wire points. FIRST WIRE EXECUTED from the sweep: the stored-signal env bridge - the prod slate passed bare process.env to the registry while the weather cron writes to game_signals, so wind-elasticity silently abstained in production; bridge injects DB weather env-shaped, typecheck green, suites green.
